summary: Check the duplicated stem III synopsis
rationale: The batch has two stem III records. The first has empty forms and a sense containing a grammatical synopsis with preterit maḥṣele and SZ 15.2; the second has maḥṣele/maḥṣe and the example maḥṣele, he shut. The synopsis is also in the head. This looks like duplicated structural material rather than a separate stem or sense. The supplied evidence does not establish how SZ 15.2 relates to the Sterka Zera note, so consolidation and preservation of that reference need editorial checking.
